fact: The Bank of Mauritius launched BOMStats, its statistical data platform at https://bomstats.bom.mu, on 3 September 2026, giving access to the Bank's official statistics with self-service analytics, an API and SDMX-format data sharing; the release gives no dataset count and no licence.

The strategy describes the National Open Data Portal, set up under the May 2017 National Open Data Policy of the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation and administered by the Central Open Data Team, as the primary platform for discovery of and access to government datasets released as open data in CSV and XML; it gives no dataset count, and the as_of is the document's published date, as it describes the portal as running.

UNDP reports that Statistics Mauritius, with UNDP, officially launched the MauStats web-based data platform on 22 October 2025, a one-stop hub to collect, analyse and share data through interactive dashboards, built to SDMX data exchange standards.
